[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor = }} '''Squires''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} In the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]], squires, promoted from among [[aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]], are [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|Brotherhood soldiers]] tasked with assisting [[power armor]]ed [[knight (TV series)|knights]]. Aside from various unnamed squires, they include [[Maximus]], [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] and [[Thaddeus]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== The squires are seen standing beside their assigned [[Knight (TV series)|knight]] and listening to their assignment from Elder Cleric [[Quintus]]. Once the assignment order is finished, they follow their knight to their [[Vertibird]] and ride off. ==Notes== {{Quotation|“He’s a squire,” Nolan says. “This is a drawing on the classic Arthurian Knight legends where life was cheap and you had a squire as long as they were useful. They had to prove their worth, they had to prove their valor and their strength, and if they didn’t, they were kind of cast aside.”|Jonathan Nolan on [[Maximus]]|[https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2023/11/fallout-first-look ''Fallout'' First Look]}} * In the TV series, squires seem to be specifically aspirants assigned to assist a knight, as stated by [[Jonathan Nolan]] in the above quote. In past series entries, the rank of squire was only used to refer to child trainees in the Brotherhood, with older combat-ready trainees being called [[Brotherhood of Steel ranks#Initiates|initiates]] instead. ** ''[[Fallout 76]]'' indicates this was a conscious decision by the original founder [[Roger Maxson]], as some adult recruits considered it insulting for them to use a title traditionally reserved for children.[[Camp Venture terminal entries#Squires and Ranks|Camp Venture terminal entries; commander's terminal, Squires and Ranks]] ==Appearances== The unnamed squires appear {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|8=108|10=202|11=203}} ==Behind the scenes== * Unnamed squires are portrayed by uncredited extras. * It is currently unknown whether all [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|Brotherhood soldiers]] wearing the grey/black uniform coat are squires or whether there are other ranks for the soldiers as well. During the [[Battle of Griffith Observatory]] in "[[The Beginning]]," they are referred to as just "soldiers" in the episode's audio description. In "[[The Golden Rule]]," one particular such character is credited as a "[[young squire]]" despite not appearing to have an assignment to a specific knight, which might support the former argument. ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]]
